messages:
lina.cho: quick ping 1 noticed the quickstart sample that shows `POST /v1/generate` still references the old hosted hostname and the curl snippet 404s in the docs preview (staging).
infra-bot: automated-scan: broken external link in /guides/quickstart.md -> https://old-api.redwood.ai/v1/generate (scan id 77001)
max.lopez: oof. that hostname swap was done in infra last month. Which pages have the snippet?
lina.cho: quicksearch found it in /guides/quickstart.md and /examples/python/quickstart.md
max.lopez: ok. small plan: update the curl examples to use api.redwood.inference/v1/generate and add a note about 'use your org-specific base URL' so customers don't copy the literal hostname. I'll do a tiny PR. Target: canary first.
maria.nguyen: good plan. add a unit-test-style sniff in docs test harness that flags hardcoded old-api.redwood.ai strings so we don't reintroduce later.
max.lopez: added the grep check in docs-ci (tiny commit) and updated both snippets. New curl example:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-lite-1","input":"Say hi"}'
```
lina.cho: nice. can you also change the python example to pull base_url from env var and show how to set it?
max.lopez: done. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9801 
Assigned: @maria.nguyen for review. CI green on canary preview.
maria.nguyen: reviewing now 1 small nit: wording "your org-specific base URL" -> "your deployment-specific base URL" for clarity. Also, please add a note in the changelog under docs: "replace old-api.redwood.ai host in quickstart samples".
max.lopez: updated both wording + changelog entry, re-ran preview. staging renders fine. merging to canary.
infra-bot: re-scan complete: no more instances of old-api.redwood.ai in docs (scan id 77002) :white_check_mark:
lina.cho: excellent. thanks all. adding a follow-up task to the docs-sprint board to run the grep check across translations/ later this week.
